Coram : ABHAY MANOHAR SAPRE*, DINESH MAHESHWARI
Arbitration Act, 1940: s. 20 – Application for appointment of arbitrator – In terms of arbitration clause in the partnership deed – Preliminary objection as to maintainability of the application on the ground that the same was barred u/s. 69(3) of Partnership Act as it – Courts below held that the application was maintainable – On appeal, held: Matter remitted to High Court for deciding the issue keeping in view law laid down in *Krishna Motor Service case – Partnership Act, 1932 – s.69(3). Allowing the appeal, the Court HELD: High
Decision Date : 04-04-2019 | Case No : CIVIL APPEAL No. 3399/2019 | Disposal Nature : Appeal(s) allowed | Bench : 2 Judges
